subject: Recap + ask: buy‑committee composition and audit/evidence path
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.p@clearwavehealth.com>, procurement@clearwavehealth.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 15:02:12 -0700
Subject: Recap + ask: buy‑committee composition and audit/evidence path

Thanks again for carving out time today — great conversation and helpful context on Clearwave's immediate pilot priorities. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay synchronized: 

Call highlights
- Pilot goal: integrate Redwood Inference for summarization and clinical note generation in a 6‑week PoC.
- Primary decision criteria you shared: response latency (p99 target < 300ms), data residency (HIPAA-controlled within us-east-1), audit logs/KV cache retention for 90 days, and clear egress/ingress encryption & key management.
- Risk gates: security sign-off, procurement SOW + PO, and legal SLA review.

Attachments included: SLA_summary.pdf (short), SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx (checklist) — attaching for your security/procurement teams to preview.

Asks / next steps
1) Can you share a compact buy‑committee map (org chart or list) that shows economic buyer, procurement contact, legal owner, and cloud/security owner? We mainly need names + emails and current authority (approve/review/influence).
2) Please introduce Alan Ruiz (economic buyer) and Nora Klein (legal) on an intro thread if possible — we’ll share a draft SOW and SLA for redline.
3) Sonia Iyer (cloud security) — could we schedule a 30‑minute technical sync next week to walk through SOC2 artifacts and encryption/KMS requirements?
4) Procurement cadence: what is your typical review window for SOW + PO? If you can share target dates we’ll align our commercial team.

Proposed timeline
- Org chart + intros: within 3 business days
- Security sync: within 7 business days
- Draft SOW in parallel after intros (we can target a one‑week turnaround)

We’ll loop Ben for pricing details and Marissa for the commercial path. Happy to jump back on a call if that’s easier.

Thanks —
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0142
From: Maya Patel <maya.p@clearwavehealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + ask: buy‑committee composition and audit/evidence path

Thanks Dylan — appreciate the clear recap and the attachments. Attaching a compact org chart and a tentative procurement timeline for your team. High level contacts below: 

- Alan Ruiz, VP Procurement — alan.ruiz@clearwavehealth.com (will own budget sign-off)
- Nora Klein, Dir Legal — nora.klein@clearwavehealth.com (contract/SLA reviewer)
- Sonia Iyer, Head of Cloud Security — sonia.iy@clearwavehealth.com (infosec point of contact)
- Maya Patel, Sr Product Manager — maya.p@clearwavehealth.com (day‑to‑day champion)

Procurement notes: typical review window for a purchase at this scope is 3–4 weeks once SOW + initial security artifacts are shared. We generally need SOC2 summary plus any data retention guarantees to go to legal.

Attachments: Clearwave_org_chart_v2.pdf, procurement_timeline.xlsx

I’ll start an intro thread to Alan and Nora in a follow up email — copying you here so you have their correct addresses.

Best,
Maya
Product Manager, Clearwave Health

Hi Alan / Nora / Sonia — thanks Maya for the intro and for sending the org chart. Per our discovery call, I’m sharing a short packet so your teams can triage the main artifacts quickly:

What we attached (links below)
- Draft SOW (draft to be uploaded to DocuSign once we have legal feedback)
- SLA_summary.pdf (p99 latency targets, uptime SLA, remedies)
- SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx (matrix to capture evidence vs. artifacts)

Quick asks for each owner
- Alan (procurement): what is the PO / signature cadence and are there any internal approval thresholds we should be aware of? Also, if there’s a preferred pricing cadence (annual vs monthly) please flag.
- Nora (legal): would you prefer a redline in Word/DocuSign or do you want to receive a marked‑up PDF first? Also curious if Clearwave has any non‑standard indemnity/privacy clauses we should preempt.
- Sonia (infosec): would you and your team be available for a 30‑minute technical sync next Tue/Wed (options below) to validate encryption, KMS, and log retention?

Available slots (PDT): Tue 21 Mar 10:00–12:00, Wed 22 Mar 09:00–11:00. If none of these work, propose two windows that do.

HubSpot deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890
DocuSign placeholder (draft): https://www.docusign.com/1234/clearwave-rwd-draft

I’ll follow up internally to align pricing and expected concessions. Thanks and speak soon —
Dylan
